title: Samsung is expected to more than double output of its HBM4 and HBM4E DRAM
why_read: Concrete supply-side news about HBM4/HBM4E memory production capacity, which directly affects AI accelerator availability and pricing.
analysis: This reports that Samsung plans to significantly ramp up production of HBM4 and HBM4E, the next-generation high-bandwidth memory used in AI accelerators like GPUs and custom silicon. HBM supply is currently a major bottleneck for AI chip makers, so a doubling in output from a major supplier has real implications for hardware availability and pricing across the industry. This is more of a hardware/business story than a deep technical one, but it's grounded in a concrete, verifiable claim rather than speculation.
